summary: Full backend + frontend regression for The Hungry Trailer fleet booking redesign. 8/8 pytest backend tests pass and every requested UI flow (homepage hero, nav, 3 trailer cards, FAQ accordion, /trailers/:id detail page, availability calendar, calendar-to-form date prefill, booking submit -> REQUEST SENT, header nav back to home, Facebook Live banner) was verified end-to-end against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
passed: GET /api/trailers -> 200 with 3 trailers whose ids are exactly {hungry-trailer, hungry-trailer-2, hungarian-trailer}
GET /api/trailers/hungry-trailer -> 200 with id, name, tagline, menu, description, best_for, setup_size, electricity, self_contained, serving_capacity, certificates
GET /api/trailers/does-not-exist -> 404
GET /api/availability/hungry-trailer -> 200 with trailer_id + booked_dates array shape
POST /api/bookings with full payload (incl. trailer_id, event_location, electricity_available) -> 201 with echoed fields, status='new', uuid id
POST /api/bookings with unknown trailer_id -> 400
POST /api/bookings twice for same trailer_id + event_date -> first 201, second 409 (double-booking blocked)
GET /api/availability/{trailer_id} now includes the newly booked event_date
POST /api/bookings missing event_location -> 422
Home page loads: STREET FOOD headline, 'done RIGHT', 'Book Us For Your Event' + 'View Our Trailers' CTAs all present
Header nav testids present and correct: nav-trailers, nav-about, nav-reviews, nav-faq, nav-find-us, nav-booking
Trailers section renders all 3 cards with testids trailer-card-hungry-trailer / -2 / hungarian-trailer, each with a working 'View Details' link
FAQ section renders faq-item-0..5 and faq-toggle-0..5; toggle expands/collapses (height 156 -> 84 -> 156 on repeated clicks)
Clicking 'View Details' on hungry-trailer card navigates to /trailers/hungry-trailer
TrailerDetail page shows name, gallery grid (gallery-img-0..7), What We Serve list, Best For tags, specs (setup size / electricity / capacity / self-contained), Insurance & Certificates block
availability-calendar-hungry-trailer renders (react-day-picker), 35 enabled day buttons in future month, booked dates are disabled
Clicking an available future date shows request-this-date-btn and pre-fills booking-date input (verified value '2026-09-10')
Booking form on TrailerDetail is pre-selected with the correct trailer_id (booking-trailer input_value == 'hungry-trailer')
Booking form submission with all new fields (trailer_id, event_location, electricity checked) -> booking-success visible with text 'REQUEST SENT'; toast 'BOOKING REQUEST SENT!' shown
From trailer detail page, clicking nav-trailers navigates back to /#trailers (home + section anchor)
Find Us: facebook-live-banner is present and links to https://www.facebook.com/thehungrytrailer
critical_code_review_comments: Booking model: `Booking(BookingCreate)` uses default status='new' and a client-side generated UUID; fine for MVP but consider server-side authoritative id and enum for status.

Double-booking check + insert is not atomic (find_one then insert_one). Under concurrent requests two 201s could slip through for the same date. Consider a unique compound index on {trailer_id, event_date} where status in ('new','confirmed') for a hard guarantee.
Availability endpoint does not paginate or bound date range; fine now (limit=2000) but worth a note.
Frontend Booking.jsx: initial() is called on every render inside useState default; harmless but could be `useState(() => initial(...))` to avoid recompute.
AvailabilityCalendar swallows fetch errors silently (.catch(() => {})). Would be better to surface a toast/inline error so users know the calendar is stale.
process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is read at build-time in CRA; that is expected and correct here.
test_credentials: n/a — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST_ prefixed bookings in MongoDB via API for booking + double-booking + availability tests. Dates used are far-future (2099-*) so they will not collide with UI booked-date views.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. TEST_ bookings for trailer_ids hungarian-trailer/hungry-trailer on 2099-* dates exist in mongo; safe to leave, they don't affect UI. Frontend uses react-day-picker; use `button.rdp-day:not([disabled])` to select an available day. External URL: https://graffiti-grub.preview.emergentagent.com.
